description.value: Osoyoos Fruit Basket is a farm stand and farmers market vendor on Highway 3 (Crowsnest Hwy) in Osoyoos, selling fresh locally-grown fruits and vegetables straight from the orchard. Situated in the heart of South Okanagan fruit country, it offers cyclists a chance to pick up seasonal produce — including early-season Chelan cherries — right along one of BC's most popular touring routes. With in-store pickup and a direct-from-farm focus, it's a practical and characterful resupply stop.
